message.content:
The description is too thin to classify with certainty. It gives only a vest with raw armholes and five non-functional buttons. It does not state the fiber content, whether the vest is knit or woven, or whether it is for men or women. I assumed a woven vest for women or girls in man-made fibers, which is a common type of article. That points to heading 6211 or 6206, though a vest is more likely classified under 6110 if knit, or 6211 as a "garment, n.e.s."

Other candidate headings are 6104 and 6204. Under HTSUS, women's suit-type vests are in 6204, and women's waistcoats in 6204.62 are trousers, so those don't fit. Women's knit vests are in 6110.30 (sweaters, waistcoats of man-made fibers). A buttoned vest with raw armholes is more likely a woven waistcoat. For women's woven vests, 6211.43 covers other garments of man-made fibers.

For men's, 6211.33 covers other garments of man-made fibers. I'll pick a women's vest in man-made fibers under 6211.43.

6211.43.9060 is "Women's or girls' other garments, of man-made fibers: Other: Other: Vests." I am not fully sure of the statistical suffix.
